turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Having reliable comfort foods is always nice. How are things going at your climate-tech company? I imagine managing the engineering team keeps your days pretty full.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A sleeping Labrador is the perfect office companion. It sounds like you've built a really wonderful routine here in Denver with Arjun and Biscuit. I hope the rest of your week goes smoothly with the upcoming release!

turns.speaker: user
